# Fixture interview — Head of Operations, illustrative

*Fixture content for the ingest pipeline smoke test. Not a real interview; a role,
not a named person. Used to exercise convert → field-artefact → extraction.*

The Head of Operations described the main pressure on the business as rising
customer churn over the last two quarters. The stated goal is to improve customer
retention to above 90% within the year.

They noted a regulatory obligation: the organisation must file a quarterly
compliance report with the sector regulator. They also flagged a constraint —
customer data cannot be stored outside the home jurisdiction.

Two systems came up: the CRM (the system of record for customer accounts) and a
billing application that integrates with it nightly. The Head of Operations is the
accountable owner for the retention goal and cares strongly about the outcome.
